verdict.rationale: Several items point toward open, portable data. Agent memory is stored as Markdown files in a Git-backed memory repository, and the vendor describes memory as text/files based. Local mode and self-hosting keep all agent state, including messages, memory and provider connections, on your own machine, and skills are portable to other agents. However, nothing documents an export of all data (message history, agent configuration, cloud-hosted agents) in open formats or a migration path off Letta Cloud. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or agent export feature, open-format export of conversation history and agent config, guidance on retrieving cloud-hosted data before leaving, and independent corroboration.
